hero.headline: Democratizing Law Through Technology
hero.subheadline: India's most advanced AI legal workspace for lawyers, judges, students, researchers and law firms.
hero.layout: Centered massive serif headline, glowing gold accents, abstract dark background image with heavy vignette. Use crystal glassmorphism nav.

homepage.modules_showcase: Bento grid layout showing cards for JusticeBot, Indian Legal Database, and Knowledge Hub. Use glassmorphism cards.

justicebot_chat.layout: Sidebar with history, main chat area. Dark sophisticated chat bubbles. User bubbles: subtle glassmorphism. AI bubbles: dark surface with subtle gold border. Include language selector (English/Hindi/Gujarati).
justicebot_chat.disclaimer: AI responses are for legal research assistance only and do not constitute legal advice.

indian_legal_database.layout: Search bar with deep focus state. Sidebar filters for Supreme Court / High Court / Statutes / Corporate. Search results in crisp, minimal list view with monospace metadata tags (LEGAL SOURCE, DATE).

knowledge_hub.layout: Editorial masonry grid. Large serif titles for articles. Monospace category pills and date labels. High contrast reading experience.

careers.layout: Grid of glassmorphism job cards. Distinct 'Rs. 15,000 / Month' stipends highlighted in gold text. Ivory 'Quick Apply' pill buttons.

auth.layout: Split screen: left side atmospheric legal background, right side minimalist login form with Google login integration. Inputs: border-b only or subtle glassmorphism.

pricing.layout: 3-column pricing tier (Free / Student / Advocate / Law Firm). Highlight 'Advocate' with a subtle glowing gold border.

admin_dashboard.layout: Strict grid hierarchy, cardless or ultra-minimal borders. Sidebar navigation. High-density data tables for content management, judgment upload, and analytics.

hero_background.description: Cinematic dark background with subtle gold geometric lines. Use for Hero background.

scales_of_justice.description: Premium 3D scales of justice in gold against black background. Use in footer or Auth section.

knowledge_hub_bg.description: Abstract legal document hologram. Good for Knowledge Hub header.

supreme_court_bw.description: Black and white Supreme Court building silhouette.

lawyer_working.description: Lawyer working at a desk in a dark room. Good for Careers or About section.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure ivory text on black background meets WCAG AAA standards. Use APCA for evaluating text over glassmorphism.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: React JS, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI (.js files ONLY, NO .tsx).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Force dark mode. Do not include light mode toggle unless strictly required. Set global background to #0A0A0A.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts_setup: Import Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, and Space Mono from Google Fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. For the footer scales-of-justice icon, use the provided scales_of_justice image asset or a custom SVG.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_overrides: Override Shadcn cards to use the defined glassmorphism classes. Override Shadcn buttons to be pill-shaped (`rounded-full`).
